goal: Land the partitioned event-store + per-entity derived-state feature from expedition 01604a3df9d2785d: (1) PartitionedEvent chunking in src/infra/event-store.ts (.synth/data/event-stream/<partition>/<segment>.jsonl with offset-ordered manifest, deterministic replay preserved); (2) StateStore.save writes per-entity derived files instead of monolithic canonical-state.json (aggregate becomes generated); (3) dependsOn as settable canonical attribute via expedition refine --depends-on; (4) archive relocates per-entity file.
